meaning: Priorities P1/P2 are proposed adoption priority, not roadmap phases or empirical rankings; excluded means removed from future reproduction priorities. current_reproduction_priorities alone defines the current focus; other entries remain background references. task_status is planning status, independent of runtime_verification_status and integration_status. planned integration means no integration implemented. source_imported means pinned source and offline preparation exist, not live integration or reproduced results. modularized means source-derived capabilities are maintained in the SAGE package and its offline controller runs with injected fakes; it does not imply live APIs or scientific results were verified.

entries.borrow: 引用链、证据提取、趋势与实体综合、想法生成/新颖性筛查、两两比较、实验方案与证据支持的 review/refinement 已拆入 SAGE 的独立模块。
entries.caution: 实际 API 兼容性、文献召回和科研效果尚未验证；live 默认仅题录/摘要，全文需显式 local article。CoI 提案命令不自动执行实验；新增 laboratory 链单独 opt-in。调用/token 限制不是美元预算或操作系统沙箱。

entries.borrow: MLESolver 的 EDIT/REPLACE、代码候选修复/改进、尝试历史与最佳候选，以及 PaperSolver 的分节报告/评审已拆入 SAGE。
